description: The general name of the product, such as milk.
The general category of the product such as mutton in the meat product.
The product type like honey type in cream product.
Amount of the fat content of a food product such as milk or yogurt.
Freshness or shelf life of an edible product such as milk.
Descriptive size of a product, for example, large-size mineral water.
The brand of a product.
Sub-brand of a famous brand. for example, Pompina is a sub-brand of the Kaleh brand.
The volume of a product such as milk.
Different shapes of cheeses.
The weight of a product.
The taste of an edible product such as the taste of a juice.
Carbonated or non-carbonated products such as soft drinks.
Buttermilk with vegetables or without vegetables.
Large size for beverage products such as soda or mineral water.
The type of packaging of a product such as bottled soda.
The Brewable or urgency of products such as tea or coffee.
Number of bags for products such as tea bags.
The numerical size of some products. Like a shoe in size 36.
Descriptive color of a product. For example, a blue T-shirt.
The numerical color of a product, for example, hair color.
Country of manufacture of a product.
The percentage of something in a product, such as the percentage of meat in a hamburger.
The height of a product.
The width of a product.
The length of a product.
The Diameter of a product of a product
Material used in a product for example silk in clothing.
The number in the packaging of products that are sold in bulk. For example, a pack involved 8 paper towels.
Types of skin for which the product is suitable, such as face cream.
Types of hair for which the product is suitable, such as shampoo.
The gender of the person who consumes the product, such as women's shoes.
The energy consumption of an electrical product such as a refrigerator.
The capacity of a product. for example the capacity of a washing machine.
The price of a product.
